_comment: Release notes for App Store 1.2.4. The rest of what changed since 1.2.3 already reached users over the air, so these notes cover only what needed a new binary.
en-US:
• Fixed: while a fast was running, its timer in the Dynamic Island stretched across the top of the screen and hid the clock. The island now stays just wide enough for the timer.
• Ready for iOS 27.
• Smaller fixes and polish.
es-MX:
• Arreglado: mientras corría un ayuno, su contador en la Dynamic Island se estiraba por toda la parte de arriba de la pantalla y tapaba la hora. Ahora la isla ocupa solo lo que necesita el contador.
• Listo para iOS 27.
• Correcciones y mejoras menores.
